hq_location.notes: Both company profile sources identify Washington, D.C. as headquarters/head office.

public_docs.notes: Bizagi has a public help/documentation portal with multiple product and technical articles.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located round was the September 2017 investment, well before the 18-month period beginning 2025-05-09.

founded_year.notes: Bizagi states it was founded in Bogotá in 1989.

last_funding.notes: Reports identify a $48 million minority private-equity investment from Invus in September 2017; Bizagi later referenced that investment.

launched_6mo.notes: Bizagi announced its Summer 2026 platform release on July 21, 2026, within the six-month window.

pricing_page.notes: A dedicated pricing page exists and describes consumption-based pricing, even though it does not publish numerical prices.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 201–500 employees; Gartner lists the same band.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page points to an active Workday job board, but current open titles could not be retrieved to determine whether it lists qualifying sales roles.

model_provider.notes: The documentation describes Azure AI Content Safety guardrails and built-in filters for Azure OpenAI models, but does not specify exact models.
model_provider.value: Bizagi publicly identifies Azure AI Content Safety and Azure OpenAI as part of its AI security/LLM interaction safeguards; it does not name specific underlying model versions.

named_customers.notes: Both customer names appear on the company's customer stories page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page links to a live Workday job board, but the board could not be inspected to verify currently open titles.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust/security material names ISO 27001 as an aligned information-security standard. NIST and FedRAMP are also mentioned, but they are not among the certification choices requested.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Bizagi's connector documentation visibly names these CRM platforms.

product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform as bringing together process design, execution, AI, and governance.
product_one_liner.value: Bizagi provides an enterprise low-code business orchestration platform for organizations to analyze, optimize, and automate business processes across people and systems.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists executives but gives no appointment dates; no verifiable join/departure announcement was found, so absence cannot be established.
